pooled_per_Mb: total candidates / total unique scanned Mb; a ratio estimator weighted by genome length
unique_scanned_Mb: union of window spans per contig, NOT summed window length, which would double-count the 50% stride overlap
interval: 10000 genome-level bootstrap resamples, seed 20261017; genomes are resampled with replacement and the ratio recomputed, because candidates cluster within genomes
why_not_window_level: window- or nucleotide-level intervals would assume candidates are independent across a genome, which they are not, and would understate the interval several-fold
n_genomes_vs_rated: n_genomes counts every scanned contig; the per-genome distribution uses only those with >=50000 nt scanned, since a rate over a few kb is dominated by noise
reporting_rule: a pooled rate must never be quoted without its per-genome distribution and n_genomes. Panels below ~20 genomes have intervals too wide to support cross-round comparison.
not_an_FDR: these are candidate yields, not FDR, precision or biological probabilities; no candidate here is human-confirmed
